title: Put these events in order: The Days of Creation

events_in_order.event: Light is divided from darkness
events_in_order.current_kjv: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light. And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness. And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

events_in_order.event: The firmament divides the waters
events_in_order.current_kjv: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters. And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so. And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

events_in_order.event: Dry land appears and plants grow
events_in_order.current_kjv: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so. And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good. And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so. And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good. And the evening and the morning were the third day.

events_in_order.event: The sun, moon and stars are set in the sky
events_in_order.current_kjv: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so. And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also. And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth, And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good. And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.

events_in_order.event: Sea creatures and birds are created
events_in_order.current_kjv: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven. And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good. And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth. And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

title: Put these events in order: Noah and the Flood

events_in_order.event: God tells Noah to build an ark of gopher wood
events_in_order.current_kjv: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

events_in_order.event: Noah's family and the animals go into the ark
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood. Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth, There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.

events_in_order.event: Rain falls for forty days and forty nights
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

events_in_order.event: A dove returns with an olive leaf
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

events_in_order.event: God sets His bow in the cloud as a covenant sign
events_in_order.current_kjv: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

title: Put these events in order: The Journey of Abraham

events_in_order.event: God calls Abram to leave his country
events_in_order.current_kjv: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

events_in_order.event: God promises descendants like the stars
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

events_in_order.event: Abram's name is changed to Abraham
events_in_order.current_kjv: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.

events_in_order.event: Isaac is born to Sarah
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

events_in_order.event: Abraham is tested in the land of Moriah
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

title: Put these events in order: The Life of Jacob

events_in_order.event: Jacob is born holding Esau's heel
events_in_order.current_kjv: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

events_in_order.event: Esau sells his birthright for pottage
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob. Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

events_in_order.event: Jacob dreams of a ladder to heaven
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

events_in_order.event: Jacob wrestles and is renamed Israel
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

title: Put these events in order: Joseph's Rise in Egypt

events_in_order.event: Jacob gives Joseph a coat of many colours
events_in_order.current_kjv: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

events_in_order.event: Joseph's brothers sell him for twenty pieces of silver
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

events_in_order.event: Joseph serves in Potiphar's house
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

events_in_order.event: Joseph interprets Pharaoh's dream
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.

events_in_order.event: Joseph reveals himself to his brothers
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

title: Put these events in order: Out of Egypt

events_in_order.event: Baby Moses is placed among the bulrushes
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.

events_in_order.event: God speaks from the burning bush
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

events_in_order.event: The river is turned to blood
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

events_in_order.event: The first Passover is kept
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you , when I smite the land of Egypt.

events_in_order.event: Israel crosses the Red Sea on dry ground
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

title: Put these events in order: Wilderness Wanderings

events_in_order.event: God provides manna
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when the children of Israel saw it , they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was . And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.

events_in_order.event: The Ten Commandments are given at Sinai
events_in_order.current_kjv: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

events_in_order.event: The people make a golden calf
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

events_in_order.event: Twelve spies are sent to search Canaan
events_in_order.current_kjv: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

title: Put these events in order: The Plagues on Egypt

events_in_order.event: Waters turned to blood
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

events_in_order.event: Frogs cover the land
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

events_in_order.event: Dust becomes lice
events_in_order.current_kjv: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

events_in_order.event: Thick darkness for three days
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:

events_in_order.event: Death of the firstborn
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

title: Put these events in order: Into the Promised Land

events_in_order.event: Rahab hides the spies in Jericho
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there. And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country. And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country. And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

events_in_order.event: Israel crosses the Jordan on dry ground
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

events_in_order.event: The walls of Jericho fall
events_in_order.current_kjv: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

events_in_order.event: The sun stands still at Gibeon
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.

title: Put these events in order: Gideon's Three Hundred

events_in_order.event: An angel appears to Gideon by the winepress
events_in_order.current_kjv: And there came an angel of the LORD , and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abi-ezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites. And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

events_in_order.event: Gideon tests God with a fleece
events_in_order.current_kjv: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside , then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.

events_in_order.event: God reduces the army to three hundred
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.

events_in_order.event: Trumpets sound and pitchers are broken
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD , and of Gideon.

title: Put these events in order: The Story of Samson

events_in_order.event: An angel announces a Nazarite son
events_in_order.current_kjv: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

events_in_order.event: Samson tears a young lion
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him. And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

events_in_order.event: Samson loves Delilah
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

events_in_order.event: Samson brings down the house
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.

title: Put these events in order: Ruth's Faithfulness

events_in_order.event: Ruth vows to go with Naomi
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

events_in_order.event: Ruth gleans in the field of Boaz
events_in_order.current_kjv: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.

events_in_order.event: Ruth asks Boaz to spread his skirt over her
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.

events_in_order.event: Boaz marries Ruth
events_in_order.current_kjv: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the LORD gave her conception, and she bare a son.

events_in_order.event: Obed is born
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

title: Put these events in order: Samuel the Prophet

events_in_order.event: Hannah prays and makes a vow
events_in_order.current_kjv: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the LORD , and wept sore. And she vowed a vow, and said, O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

events_in_order.event: The LORD calls the boy Samuel
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

events_in_order.event: Samuel anoints Saul
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not because the LORD hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance?

events_in_order.event: Samuel anoints David
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

title: Put these events in order: David's Path to the Throne

events_in_order.event: Samuel anoints David
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

events_in_order.event: David plays the harp for Saul
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

events_in_order.event: David defeats Goliath
events_in_order.current_kjv: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.

events_in_order.event: David spares Saul in the cave
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.

events_in_order.event: David is anointed king over Israel
events_in_order.current_kjv: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD : and they anointed David king over Israel.

title: Put these events in order: Solomon's Reign

events_in_order.event: Solomon asks for an understanding heart
events_in_order.current_kjv: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

events_in_order.event: Solomon judges between two mothers
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

events_in_order.event: Solomon builds the house of the LORD
events_in_order.current_kjv: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

events_in_order.event: The temple is dedicated
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD , two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD .

events_in_order.event: The queen of Sheba visits
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD , she came to prove him with hard questions.

title: Put these events in order: Elijah the Prophet

events_in_order.event: Ravens feed Elijah
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

events_in_order.event: The widow's meal and oil do not run out
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by Elijah.

events_in_order.event: Fire falls on Mount Carmel
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

events_in_order.event: Elijah hears a still small voice
events_in_order.current_kjv: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

events_in_order.event: Elijah goes up by a whirlwind
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

title: Put these events in order: Daniel in Babylon

events_in_order.event: Daniel refuses the king's meat
events_in_order.current_kjv: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

events_in_order.event: Daniel interprets the dream of the great image
events_in_order.current_kjv: Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before thee; and the form thereof was terrible.

events_in_order.event: Three friends are cast into the furnace
events_in_order.current_kjv: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

events_in_order.event: Fingers write on the palace wall
events_in_order.current_kjv: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

events_in_order.event: Daniel is cast into the den of lions
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.

title: Put these events in order: Esther Saves Her People

events_in_order.event: Esther is made queen
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

events_in_order.event: Haman plots against the Jews
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.

events_in_order.event: Esther goes in to the king
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

events_in_order.event: Haman is hanged on his own gallows
events_in_order.current_kjv: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.

title: Put these events in order: Jonah and Nineveh

events_in_order.event: God calls Jonah to go to Nineveh
events_in_order.current_kjv: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.

events_in_order.event: Jonah flees toward Tarshish
events_in_order.current_kjv: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD , and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD .

events_in_order.event: A great fish swallows Jonah
events_in_order.current_kjv: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

events_in_order.event: Jonah warns Nineveh: forty days
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

events_in_order.event: God prepares a gourd to shade Jonah
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the LORD God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.

title: Put these events in order: The Birth of Jesus

events_in_order.event: Gabriel announces Jesus' birth to Mary
events_in_order.current_kjv: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

events_in_order.event: Joseph and Mary travel to Bethlehem
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

events_in_order.event: Angels appear to shepherds
events_in_order.current_kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night. And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

events_in_order.event: Simeon holds the child in the temple
events_in_order.current_kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him. And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ. And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law, Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

events_in_order.event: The twelve-year-old Jesus is found in the temple
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast. And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it . But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance. And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him. And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

title: Put these events in order: Jesus Begins His Ministry

events_in_order.event: Jesus is baptized
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

events_in_order.event: Jesus is tempted in the wilderness
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

events_in_order.event: Jesus calls fishermen to be fishers of men
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

events_in_order.event: Jesus teaches on the mountain
events_in_order.current_kjv: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:

title: Put these events in order: The Final Week

events_in_order.event: Crowds cry Hosanna as Jesus enters Jerusalem
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

events_in_order.event: Jesus breaks bread at the Last Supper
events_in_order.current_kjv: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it , and brake it , and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

events_in_order.event: Jesus prays in Gethsemane
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

events_in_order.event: Jesus is crucified
events_in_order.current_kjv: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.

events_in_order.event: The angel says: He is not here, for he is risen
events_in_order.current_kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

title: Put these events in order: From the Tomb to the Ascension

events_in_order.event: The women find the stone rolled away
events_in_order.current_kjv: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre. And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

events_in_order.event: Two disciples walk to Emmaus
events_in_order.current_kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

events_in_order.event: Jesus stands among the disciples: Peace be unto you
events_in_order.current_kjv: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

events_in_order.event: Jesus is carried up into heaven
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.

title: Put these events in order: The Early Church

events_in_order.event: Jesus is taken up in a cloud
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

events_in_order.event: The Spirit comes at Pentecost
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

events_in_order.event: A lame man is healed at the temple gate
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk. And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength. And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

events_in_order.event: Stephen is stoned
events_in_order.current_kjv: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God , and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

events_in_order.event: Saul meets the risen Jesus near Damascus
events_in_order.current_kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

title: Put these events in order: Paul's Journeys

events_in_order.event: Saul is converted near Damascus
events_in_order.current_kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:

events_in_order.event: Barnabas and Saul are separated for the work
events_in_order.current_kjv: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

events_in_order.event: Paul sees a vision of a man of Macedonia
events_in_order.current_kjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

events_in_order.event: Paul preaches on Mars' hill in Athens
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

events_in_order.event: Paul is shipwrecked on Melita
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.

title: Put these events in order: The Prodigal Son

events_in_order.event: The younger son asks for his portion
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me . And he divided unto them his living.

events_in_order.event: He wastes his substance with riotous living
events_in_order.current_kjv: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

events_in_order.event: He feeds swine in a far country
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

events_in_order.event: His father runs to embrace him
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

events_in_order.event: The elder brother is angry
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.

title: Put these events in order: The Good Samaritan

events_in_order.event: A traveller falls among thieves
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him , and departed, leaving him half dead.

events_in_order.event: A priest passes by
events_in_order.current_kjv: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

events_in_order.event: A Levite passes by
events_in_order.current_kjv: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him , and passed by on the other side.

events_in_order.event: A Samaritan binds up his wounds
events_in_order.current_kjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him , And went to him , and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

events_in_order.event: He pays the host two pence
events_in_order.current_kjv: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

title: Put these events in order: Cain and Abel

events_in_order.event: Abel keeps sheep and Cain tills the ground
events_in_order.current_kjv: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

events_in_order.event: Both bring offerings to the LORD
events_in_order.current_kjv: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD . And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

events_in_order.event: God warns Cain that sin lieth at the door
events_in_order.current_kjv: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.

events_in_order.event: Cain rises up against Abel in the field
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

events_in_order.event: God sets a mark upon Cain
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

title: Put these events in order: The Tower of Babel

events_in_order.event: All the earth has one language
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

events_in_order.event: People settle in a plain in the land of Shinar
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

events_in_order.event: They make brick and plan a city and a tower
events_in_order.current_kjv: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter. And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

events_in_order.event: The LORD comes down to see the city
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

events_in_order.event: Their language is confounded and they are scattered
events_in_order.current_kjv: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech. So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.

title: Put these events in order: Abraham Tested

events_in_order.event: God tells Abraham to take Isaac to the land of Moriah
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

events_in_order.event: Abraham rises early and saddles his ass
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

events_in_order.event: Isaac asks where the lamb is
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

events_in_order.event: The angel of the LORD calls out of heaven
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

events_in_order.event: A ram caught in a thicket is offered instead
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

title: Put these events in order: The Early Life of Moses

events_in_order.event: Pharaoh orders every son born to be cast into the river
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.

events_in_order.event: Baby Moses is hidden in an ark of bulrushes
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.

events_in_order.event: Pharaoh's daughter finds the child
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it. And when she had opened it , she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews’ children.

events_in_order.event: Moses flees to the land of Midian
events_in_order.current_kjv: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

events_in_order.event: God speaks from the burning bush
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed. And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt. And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

title: Put these events in order: At Mount Sinai

events_in_order.event: Israel camps before the mount
events_in_order.current_kjv: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.

events_in_order.event: Mount Sinai smokes as the LORD descends
events_in_order.current_kjv: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

events_in_order.event: God speaks the ten commandments
events_in_order.current_kjv: And God spake all these words, saying, I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage. Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

events_in_order.event: The people make a golden calf
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

events_in_order.event: Moses hews two new tables of stone
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.

title: Put these events in order: The Fall of Jericho

events_in_order.event: Rahab hides the two spies
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

events_in_order.event: Israel crosses the Jordan on dry ground
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

events_in_order.event: The people march around the city once a day for six days
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

events_in_order.event: On the seventh day they compass the city seven times
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

events_in_order.event: The wall falls down flat
events_in_order.current_kjv: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

title: Put these events in order: Hannah's Prayer

events_in_order.event: Hannah prays in bitterness of soul at Shiloh
events_in_order.current_kjv: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the LORD , and wept sore.

events_in_order.event: Eli thinks she is drunken
events_in_order.current_kjv: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.

events_in_order.event: Hannah bears a son and names him Samuel
events_in_order.current_kjv: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying , Because I have asked him of the LORD .

events_in_order.event: She lends the child to the LORD
events_in_order.current_kjv: Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD ; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD . And he worshipped the LORD there.

events_in_order.event: Hannah prays: My heart rejoiceth in the LORD
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoiceth in the LORD , mine horn is exalted in the LORD : my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; because I rejoice in thy salvation.

title: Put these events in order: Naaman Is Healed

events_in_order.event: A little maid tells of the prophet in Samaria
events_in_order.current_kjv: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.

events_in_order.event: The king of Israel rends his clothes
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.

events_in_order.event: Elisha says to wash in Jordan seven times
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.

events_in_order.event: Naaman turns away in a rage
events_in_order.current_kjv: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

events_in_order.event: His flesh comes again like a little child's
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

title: Put these events in order: Rebuilding the Walls

events_in_order.event: Nehemiah weeps over the news of Jerusalem
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,

events_in_order.event: King Artaxerxes asks why his countenance is sad
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence. Wherefore the king said unto me, Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,

events_in_order.event: Nehemiah views the walls by night
events_in_order.current_kjv: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.

events_in_order.event: Sanballat and Tobiah mock the builders
events_in_order.current_kjv: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews. And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned? Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.

events_in_order.event: The wall is finished in fifty and two days
events_in_order.current_kjv: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.

title: Put these events in order: The Fiery Furnace

events_in_order.event: Nebuchadnezzar sets up an image of gold
events_in_order.current_kjv: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

events_in_order.event: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego refuse to worship it
events_in_order.current_kjv: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

events_in_order.event: The furnace is heated seven times hotter
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.

events_in_order.event: The king sees four men loose in the fire
events_in_order.current_kjv: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

events_in_order.event: They come out with no smell of fire upon them
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king’s counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.

title: Put these events in order: The Raising of Lazarus

events_in_order.event: The sisters send word that Lazarus is sick
events_in_order.current_kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

events_in_order.event: Jesus arrives after Lazarus has lain in the grave four days
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

events_in_order.event: Jesus says: I am the resurrection, and the life
events_in_order.current_kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

events_in_order.event: Jesus weeps
events_in_order.current_kjv: Jesus wept.

events_in_order.event: Lazarus comes forth bound with graveclothes
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

title: Put these events in order: Feeding the Five Thousand

events_in_order.event: A great multitude follows Jesus
events_in_order.current_kjv: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

events_in_order.event: Jesus asks Philip where to buy bread
events_in_order.current_kjv: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

events_in_order.event: Andrew tells Jesus of a lad with five barley loaves and two small fishes
events_in_order.current_kjv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him, There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

events_in_order.event: The men sit down and Jesus gives thanks
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand. And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

events_in_order.event: Twelve baskets of fragments are gathered
events_in_order.current_kjv: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

title: Put these events in order: Saul's Conversion

events_in_order.event: Saul consents to Stephen's death
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judæa and Samaria, except the apostles.

events_in_order.event: A light from heaven shines around Saul near Damascus
events_in_order.current_kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:

events_in_order.event: Saul is three days without sight
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

events_in_order.event: Ananias lays his hands on Saul
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

events_in_order.event: Saul preaches Christ in the synagogues
events_in_order.current_kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

title: Put these events in order: Jesus and Zacchaeus

events_in_order.event: Zacchaeus, a chief among the publicans, seeks to see Jesus
events_in_order.current_kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchæus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich. And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.

events_in_order.event: He climbs up into a sycomore tree
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way .

events_in_order.event: Jesus says: to day I must abide at thy house
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

events_in_order.event: The people murmur
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when they saw it , they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

events_in_order.event: Zacchaeus gives half his goods to the poor
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

title: Put these events in order: Lot and the Cities of the Plain

events_in_order.event: Lot chooses the plain of Jordan
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

events_in_order.event: Abram hears that Lot was taken captive
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants , born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.

events_in_order.event: Two angels come to Sodom at evening
events_in_order.current_kjv: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

events_in_order.event: Lot's wife looks back
events_in_order.current_kjv: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

title: Put these events in order: A Bride for Isaac

events_in_order.event: Abraham sends his servant to his kindred
events_in_order.current_kjv: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

events_in_order.event: Rebekah offers to water the camels
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

events_in_order.event: Laban runs out to the man at the well
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

events_in_order.event: Rebekah says, I will go
events_in_order.current_kjv: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

events_in_order.event: Rebekah becomes Isaac's wife
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death .

title: Put these events in order: Jacob, Rachel and Leah

events_in_order.event: Jacob waters Rachel's flock at the well
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

events_in_order.event: Jacob serves seven years for Rachel
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

events_in_order.event: Jacob finds he has married Leah
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

events_in_order.event: Jacob serves seven more years
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

title: Put these events in order: Joseph and His Brothers in Egypt

events_in_order.event: Ten brothers go down to buy corn in Egypt
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

events_in_order.event: Simeon is bound before their eyes
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

events_in_order.event: The brothers take Benjamin down to Egypt
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

events_in_order.event: The cup is found in Benjamin's sack
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

events_in_order.event: Joseph makes himself known
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

title: Put these events in order: The Twelve Spies

events_in_order.event: Moses sends the spies to search Canaan
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

events_in_order.event: Two men carry a cluster of grapes on a staff
events_in_order.current_kjv: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

events_in_order.event: Caleb says, Let us go up at once
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

events_in_order.event: The people murmur against Moses and Aaron
events_in_order.current_kjv: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

events_in_order.event: Israel must wander forty years
events_in_order.current_kjv: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

title: Put these events in order: Balaam and the Donkey

events_in_order.event: Balaam saddles his ass and goes with the princes of Moab
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

events_in_order.event: The ass sees the angel standing in the way
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.

events_in_order.event: The LORD opens the mouth of the ass
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

events_in_order.event: The LORD opens Balaam's eyes
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

events_in_order.event: Balak complains that Balaam has blessed Israel
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.

title: Put these events in order: Deborah and Barak

events_in_order.event: Deborah judges Israel under the palm tree
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time. And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

events_in_order.event: Deborah calls Barak to Mount Tabor
events_in_order.current_kjv: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying , Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

events_in_order.event: Barak goes down from Mount Tabor
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

events_in_order.event: Jael drives a nail through Sisera's temples
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then Jael Heber’s wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

events_in_order.event: Deborah and Barak sing a song
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,

title: Put these events in order: Israel's First King

events_in_order.event: The elders ask Samuel for a king
events_in_order.current_kjv: And said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.

events_in_order.event: Saul, a choice young man, is introduced
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a choice young man, and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.

events_in_order.event: Samuel anoints Saul with a vial of oil
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not because the LORD hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance?

events_in_order.event: The people shout, God save the king
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the LORD hath chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.

events_in_order.event: Samuel tells Saul the LORD has rejected him
events_in_order.current_kjv: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD , he hath also rejected thee from being king.

title: Put these events in order: David, Bathsheba and Nathan

events_in_order.event: David sees a woman from the roof
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king’s house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

events_in_order.event: David writes to set Uriah in the hottest battle
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.

events_in_order.event: Nathan says, Thou art the man
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;

events_in_order.event: David confesses, I have sinned
events_in_order.current_kjv: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD . And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

events_in_order.event: Solomon is born
events_in_order.current_kjv: And David comforted Bath-sheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.

title: Put these events in order: Absalom's Rebellion

events_in_order.event: Absalom steals the hearts of the men of Israel
events_in_order.current_kjv: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

events_in_order.event: David flees from Jerusalem
events_in_order.current_kjv: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

events_in_order.event: Absalom's head is caught in an oak
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.

events_in_order.event: Joab thrusts three darts into Absalom
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.

events_in_order.event: David weeps, O my son Absalom
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

title: Put these events in order: The Miracles of Elisha

events_in_order.event: Elisha asks for a double portion of Elijah's spirit
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

events_in_order.event: Elisha divides the Jordan with Elijah's mantle
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.

events_in_order.event: The widow's oil flows until the vessels are full
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

events_in_order.event: The Shunammite's son sneezes seven times
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

events_in_order.event: The axe head swims
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.

title: Put these events in order: Hezekiah and the Assyrians

events_in_order.event: Hezekiah breaks the brasen serpent
events_in_order.current_kjv: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.

events_in_order.event: Sennacherib comes up against the fenced cities of Judah
events_in_order.current_kjv: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.

events_in_order.event: Hezekiah spreads the letter before the LORD
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD , and spread it before the LORD .

events_in_order.event: The angel of the LORD strikes the Assyrian camp
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

events_in_order.event: Sennacherib is slain by his sons in his own temple
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

title: Put these events in order: King Josiah's Reform

events_in_order.event: Josiah becomes king at eight years old
events_in_order.current_kjv: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

events_in_order.event: The book of the law is found in the temple
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD . And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

events_in_order.event: Josiah tears his clothes
events_in_order.current_kjv: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

events_in_order.event: Josiah makes a covenant before the LORD
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD , to walk after the LORD , and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

events_in_order.event: Josiah commands the people to keep the passover
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.

title: Put these events in order: Return and Rebuilding

events_in_order.event: Cyrus makes a proclamation
events_in_order.current_kjv: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

events_in_order.event: The foundation of the temple is laid
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD , they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD , after the ordinance of David king of Israel.

events_in_order.event: The people of the land trouble the builders
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,

events_in_order.event: The house of God is finished
events_in_order.current_kjv: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

events_in_order.event: Ezra goes up from Babylon
events_in_order.current_kjv: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.

title: Put these events in order: Walking on the Water

events_in_order.event: Jesus goes up a mountain to pray
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

events_in_order.event: The ship is tossed with waves
events_in_order.current_kjv: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

events_in_order.event: Jesus comes walking on the sea
events_in_order.current_kjv: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

events_in_order.event: Peter begins to sink and cries, Lord, save me
events_in_order.current_kjv: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

events_in_order.event: The wind ceases when they come into the ship
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.

title: Put these events in order: Jairus' Daughter

events_in_order.event: Jairus falls at Jesus' feet
events_in_order.current_kjv: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

events_in_order.event: A woman touches Jesus' garment
events_in_order.current_kjv: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

events_in_order.event: Jesus asks, Who touched my clothes?
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

events_in_order.event: Messengers say, Thy daughter is dead
events_in_order.current_kjv: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

events_in_order.event: Jesus says, Talitha cumi
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

title: Put these events in order: Peter's Denial

events_in_order.event: Peter says he is ready to go to prison and to death
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

events_in_order.event: Peter follows afar off
events_in_order.current_kjv: Then took they him, and led him , and brought him into the high priest’s house. And Peter followed afar off.

events_in_order.event: Peter says, Woman, I know him not
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

events_in_order.event: The Lord turns and looks upon Peter
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

events_in_order.event: Peter goes out and weeps bitterly
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

title: Put these events in order: Stephen the Witness

events_in_order.event: Stephen is chosen among the seven
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

events_in_order.event: Stephen does great wonders among the people
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

events_in_order.event: Stephen is brought to the council
events_in_order.current_kjv: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him , and caught him, and brought him to the council,

events_in_order.event: Stephen sees the heavens opened
events_in_order.current_kjv: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

events_in_order.event: Stephen prays, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

title: Put these events in order: Philip and the Ethiopian

events_in_order.event: An angel sends Philip toward the south
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.

events_in_order.event: Philip meets a man of Ethiopia
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,

events_in_order.event: Philip asks, Understandest thou what thou readest?
events_in_order.current_kjv: And Philip ran thither to him , and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?

events_in_order.event: Philip baptizes the eunuch
