events_in_order.current_kjv: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.

events_in_order.event: The Spirit of the Lord catches Philip away
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.

title: Put these events in order: Peter and Cornelius

events_in_order.event: Cornelius sees an angel in a vision
events_in_order.current_kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.

events_in_order.event: Peter sees a great sheet let down from heaven
events_in_order.current_kjv: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

events_in_order.event: Cornelius waits with his kinsmen and friends
events_in_order.current_kjv: And the morrow after they entered into Cæsarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

events_in_order.event: The Holy Ghost falls on all who hear
events_in_order.current_kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

events_in_order.event: Peter commands them to be baptized
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

title: Put these events in order: Peter Freed from Prison

events_in_order.event: Herod kills James with the sword
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

events_in_order.event: Peter sleeps between two soldiers
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

events_in_order.event: The chains fall off Peter's hands
events_in_order.current_kjv: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him , and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.

events_in_order.event: The iron gate opens of its own accord
events_in_order.current_kjv: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.

events_in_order.event: Rhoda is too glad to open the gate
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when she knew Peter’s voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.

title: Put these events in order: Paul and Silas at Philippi

events_in_order.event: The Lord opens Lydia's heart
events_in_order.current_kjv: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us : whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

events_in_order.event: Paul casts the spirit out of a damsel
events_in_order.current_kjv: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

events_in_order.event: Paul and Silas are cast into prison
events_in_order.current_kjv: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

events_in_order.event: At midnight they pray and sing praises
events_in_order.current_kjv: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

events_in_order.event: The jailer and all his household are baptized
events_in_order.current_kjv: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
